# mailgun_alert_events (Data Source)

Use this data source to list all available alert event types that can be used when creating alerts. Event types define what triggers an alert notification.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `events` (List of String) List of available event types for alerts.
